description: This file defines the ITransactionManagerExtension interface within the Orleans.Transactions.Abstractions namespace. It declares methods related to transaction management, such as preparing, committing, and pinging transactions, with specific attributes controlling their execution behavior.

classes.name: ITransactionManagerExtension
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainExtension, providing methods for transaction management operations such as PrepareAndCommit, Prepared, and Ping.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction with specified resource ID, transaction ID, access count, timestamp, write resources, and total participants.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Notifies that a transaction has been prepared with a specific status.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Checks the liveness of a transaction resource.
